method.package: Full collections and media maps independently parsed; raw APKG read only.
method.sample: 16 evenly spaced note indices per required/optional source; all 64 decoded to PCM 16k mono and recognized locally. One extra DJG dialogue response checked separately.
method.asr: Whisper small-q5_1, whisper.cpp v1.9.2, no reference prompt; ASR similarity is a diagnostic, not an error rate or listening certification.
method.limits: No human listening; no UI/mobile import test; sample not random or representative of whole corpus; only first audio per note in initial sample.
